subject: Hosting shinyapp with very large datasets

messages.author: e89a81c32c5122ab
messages.subject: Hosting shinyapp with very large datasets
parts:
Hi all,

I am working on using shiny to visualize a large dataset. The size of the data that users could interact with is quite like ~100g. I am currently only loading into memory what is requested based on user interaction. How can I host this app? Can shinyapp.io handle large files?

Thanks,
Daniel

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Hosting shinyapp with very large datasets
parts:
Daniel,

The maximum application size supported by shinyapps.io is 5GB, and the maximum amount of memory we allow is 8GB (on paid plans only). With such a large dataset, I don't think shinyapps.io will work very well for your use case. I would suggest looking into running shiny-server or shiny-server pro on your own server.

Hope that helps,
-Andy
